name: FabricCatalystAddAzDOEnv
description: Creates an Azure DevOps Environment (if missing), syncs its Administrators (the running identity plus a configurable set of co-administrators), and optionally configures a single approver check.
author: TechTacoFriday

inputs.name: azureSubscription
inputs.label: Azure Subscription
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure service connection used to obtain a token for the Azure DevOps REST API.

inputs.name: organizationName
inputs.label: Azure DevOps Organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure DevOps organization name (the part after dev.azure.com/).

inputs.name: projectName
inputs.label: Azure DevOps Project
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure DevOps project in which the environment will be created.

inputs.name: environmentName
inputs.label: Environment Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the Azure DevOps Environment to create (no-op if it already exists).

inputs.name: description
inputs.label: Description
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional description for the environment. Only used when the environment is first created.

inputs.name: coAdministrators
inputs.label: Co-Administrators
inputs.helpMarkDown: Semicolon-separated list of UPNs/group names to grant Administrator on the environment. Additive only - existing Administrators (including whoever creates the environment, which Azure DevOps assigns automatically) are never removed.

inputs.name: approverUpn
inputs.label: Approver
inputs.helpMarkDown: UPN or group name required to approve deployments to this environment. Leave empty to skip approval configuration. Has no effect if the environment already has an approval check configured.

inputs.name: enableDiagnostics
inputs.label: Enable Diagnostics
inputs.helpMarkDown: Outputs detailed diagnostic messages to the pipeline log.
